This '''[[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]]''' served as an '''aide''' to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
The [[Aide/Legends|aide]] accompanied [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] to [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> at the behest of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], hoping to prevent the [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth/Legends|negotiations]] between [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] envoys, Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. They later dined with Dod, Katuunko, and several [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] ministers during a ceremonial dinner. As the dinner wore on, Binks attempted to draw attention away from several supply ships being launched from the base of the castle to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], which had been invaded by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]] . The aide was quite impressed with Jar Jar, smiling throughout the show and even clapping loudly by the end — much to Dod's annoyance.

Following the dinner, Dod and his aide received word that Republic ships had penetrated the blockade around Ryloth. The aide was present when Dod attempted to confront Organa and Katuunko over their decision shortly before the two [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] departed Ryloth.
